title: Deepslate Recipe Rebalance
description: Deepslate recipes that resemble their stone variant equivalents. This is a rebalance datapack.
body: This Datapack reworks the recipes for Deepslate and Cobbled Deepslate to align it with the stone variant recipes, meaning cobbled only produces cobbled variants. All other Deepslate Variants (Polished, Tiled, Bricks) are produced by Deepslate.
